plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.38 arcseconds per year, measured over 14 years (a confident measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = at least 3.1 mag is extremely red, like the coldest brown dwarfs (late-T and Y).
